description: Send simulated people through a multi-step flow (signup, onboarding, checkout) in a real browser, clicking and typing, to find the step where they get stuck or give up. Slower than test_page, and each person uses 30 credits. Returns each person's steps, where they stopped and why.

audience.description: Who the simulated people should be, in plain words, e.g. "startup founders in SF" or "parents shopping for kids toys". If omitted, Mimiq picks the likely audience from the content.

count.description: How many simulated people (default 5, max 10; without a key a free flow has up to 3, and defaults to 3). Each runs a full browser session and uses 30 credits.

goal.description: The task each person tries, e.g. "complete the signup and reach the dashboard". Default: sign up and start using it.

url.description: Where the flow starts. Must be publicly reachable. For localhost, open a cloudflared tunnel and pass the tunnel URL.

name: mimiq.test_flow
